topic: Order of operations: 401k match, kill high-interest debt, then invest (Soren vs Marlee)

scenes.narration: Doing the right money moves in the wrong order can cost thousands every single year. I am Doctor Dollar. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room beside a numbered checklist labeled ORDER OF OPERATIONS, comic burst banner reads MONEY CHECKUP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Soren and Marlee both have spare cash and the same goals.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man soren and woman marlee each holding a cash stack labeled SPARE CASH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both carry a card at twenty two percent and a 401k match.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, doctor dollar holding a chart with a card stamped TWENTY TWO PERCENT and a 401K MATCH badge, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Soren pours everything straight into investing and ignores all the rest.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man soren dumping all cash into a stock jar, a card and match badge ignored, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He completely skips the free 401k match worth thousands yearly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man soren walking past a glowing badge labeled FREE MATCH LEFT BEHIND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His twenty two percent card debt just keeps quietly growing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a red debt meter climbing labeled TWENTY TWO PERCENT, worried man soren beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Marlee first grabs her full free 401k match from her employer.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman marlee catching a glowing badge labeled FULL MATCH STEP ONE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Next she completely crushes the high interest card debt for good.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman marlee smashing a card stamped PAID OFF STEP TWO with a hammer, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Only then does Marlee invest all the rest for growth.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman marlee dropping cash into a stock jar labeled INVEST STEP THREE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Soren's card interest quietly eats most of his investment gains.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a small gain pile being eaten by a red interest monster, glum man soren watching, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Marlee has no debt, free money, and a growing portfolio.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, smiling woman marlee beside a DEBT FREE sign, a match badge, and a tall portfolio, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Grab the match, kill high interest debt, then invest. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
